per_frame.summary: This is a **shopping bag/cart page** from a fashion e-commerce website showing two items — a **yellow textured woven sweater ($99.90)** and a **black ribbed sleeveless top ($12.90)** — with a total of **$112.80**, and checkout options via **PayPal, Apple Pay**, or a standard **Continue** button.
After clicking "Continue (2)" to proceed with the checkout, the shopping bag page transitioned to a loading screen while the next step of the checkout process is being loaded.

The loading screen with a spinner and "LOADING" text transitioned to a fully loaded shipping details form where users can enter their name, address, contact information, and other delivery-related fields with a total of **$112.80** displayed at the bottom.

Between the two screenshots, the shipping form was filled in with the user's details: **Name** ("Mido"), **Last Name** ("Sang"), **Address** ("5801 South Ellis Avenue"), **Zip Code** ("60637"), **City/Town** ("Chicago"), and **State** ("Illinois"), while the Email and Phone fields remain empty.
The apartment number "406" was added to the **Address 2** field, and an email address "zhizhongs@uchicago.edu" was entered in the **Email** field, causing the address validation warning to disappear.

The user moved from the **shipping details form** (entering personal/address information) to the **delivery options page** (selecting a shipping method and delivery date, with $4.95 standard shipping pre-selected).

The user switched the delivery option from the standard **Tuesday 19 – Wednesday 20** ($4.95) to the express **Tuesday 19** ($19.95) shipping, causing the shipping cost displayed at the bottom to update from $4.95 to $19.95.

The user progressed from the **shipping method selection screen** (choosing between delivery options with associated costs) to the **order summary screen**, which confirms the selected home delivery option (Tuesday 19 – Wednesday 20) to the address at 5801 South Ellis Avenue 406, Chicago, Illinois, with a total of $131.31.

The first screenshot shows an **Order Summary** page with delivery details, items, and shipping address, while the second screenshot replaced that content with a **Select a Payment Method** page offering multiple payment options (Credit/Debit Card, PayPal, Afterpay, Gift Card, In Card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay).
After scrolling down, the **Credit/Debit Card** payment method was selected, revealing a "Complete Payment Details" form with fields for Card Number, Expiration Date, Card Holder, and CVV Number.
